summary: Frontend-only Playwright E2E executed against live preview URL. Verified (1) the new BillProcessing switcher tabs [Vendor Bills | HR Payroll | Employee Advance] use true React conditional rendering (DOM presence verified, not just CSS visibility) and switch correctly in both directions; (2) full HR Pay Bill → GM Approve → Accounts (Bill Processing) → auto PV generation flow works end-to-end and the generated PV is listed in /final Reports.

issues: Status label at step 3 renders as 'GM Approved' (from PAYBILL_STATUS[3]) while the request's spec text calls it 'Pending Accounts Approval'. Functionally identical — the approve button is correctly shown — but consider renaming the label to 'Pending Accounts Approval' for clarity if that is the intended UX wording.

Freshly created draft shows Gross/Net = ₹ 0 for employees because no attendance has been marked for the chosen month. The flow still completes and PV is auto-generated with ₹ 0 amount. Not a blocker, but UX could warn user when all computed amounts are zero before submitting to GM.

action_items: (optional) Rename PAYBILL_STATUS[3] from 'GM Approved' to 'Pending Accounts Approval' in /app/frontend/src/lib/store.js so the Accounts-queue status matches the spec wording.
(optional) In HR Pay Bill tab, show a soft warning when all computed Net Payable amounts are 0 (likely no attendance marked) before allowing Submit to GM.
critical_code_review_comments: BillProcessing switcher rendering correctly uses conditional React rendering ({activeView === 'xyz' && ...}) — no stale DOM leaks. Good.

activeView is local useState — state is not persisted across page reloads. If user refreshes while on 'hr-payroll', they land back on 'vendor'. Consider sessionStorage/useLocation query param if the product wants deep-linking per tab.
advancePayBillStep in store.js correctly generates linkedPvNo when transitioning step 3 → 4, and the PV surfaces in Reports — integration is clean.
